name: AddWeatherEffect
notes: Returned a handle in every case of the nullability sweep (typical arguments, effectID: unknown rawcode, where: removed rect) on 3.0.0.24268; evidence, not proof. The handle had id 0 in a case (where: removed rect) and id -1 in a case (effectID: unknown rawcode) rather than nothing, so a nil check does not tell that the rect was removed or the effect is unknown.
